title: Keep European Customer Data Grounded - Without Breaking the Customer Experience
summary: Protect EU data residency while routing customer calls locally using Twilio Studio, Functions, and TaskRouter hosted in the European IE1 region.
body_markdown:
When a customer reaches out for help, nobody wants to think about where their data is travelling just to verify an account number or route a call. Yet for organizations operating in Europe, keeping sensitive customer interactions within EU borders often meant making an uncomfortable choice: deal with complex compliance headaches or compromise on customer experience.


With Twilio[Studio](https://www.twilio.com/docs/studio) ,[Functions](https://www.twilio.com/docs/serverless/functions-assets) , and[TaskRouter](https://www.twilio.com/docs/taskrouter) fully hosted in the European region, engineering teams can pair strict in region data residency with context rich customer journeys, giving callers fast, connected handoffs without their data ever leaving home.


Every piece of your customer orchestration, from visual IVR workflows and intelligent agent routing to custom backend logic, now runs and stores data strictly inside European borders. For security, compliance, and customer experience leaders, that means delivering fast, connected customer journeys while keeping data safely at home.


## Expand in Europe without the architectural gymnastics


Data residency shouldn't come at the expense of a great customer experience. When Studio, Functions and Assets, and TaskRouter run together in the same European region, your systems can keep up with customer needs in real time without data ever leaving the EU.


Think about what that looks like on a live support call. Twilio Studio keeps your self-service IVR flows running right in the Twilio Ireland (IE1) region, so callers get immediate, low-latency answers. Behind the scenes, Functions & Assets checks spoken account numbers or local databases in milliseconds to keep things moving smoothly. And the second an automated flow hits a snag, TaskRouter steps in to pass the call, verified details, and full context straight to the right agent.


Your customers get fast, frustration-free help without having to repeat themselves, and your compliance team gets complete peace of mind.


## Seamless handoffs that keep customers happy


Data residency shouldn't come at the expense of a smooth customer journey. When Studio, Functions & Assets, and TaskRouter run together in the same European region, your systems can react to customer needs in milliseconds:


- **Twilio Studio** keeps your visual IVR and self-service flows running locally in IE1, ensuring low latency and responsive interactions.
- **Twilio Functions & Assets** executes custom backend logic right in the region, validating spoken account numbers or checking local databases on the fly without data ever leaving the EU.
- **Twilio TaskRouter** monitors live agent queues and skills locally. The moment a self-service flow hits a snag, TaskRouter passes the call, verified details, and full context straight to the right specialist so customers never have to repeat themselves.


## What to keep in mind as you plan for IE1


As your teams architect workflows for the European region, here are a few practical guardrails to align your technical and compliance stakeholders early:


- **Voice first:** Studio, TaskRouter, and Functions and Assets in IE1 work with Programmable Voice, such as self-service IVRs and contact center routing. Conversations (classic) is available in IE1 for the Chat channel only.
- **Channel availability:** While inbound SMS can trigger Studio flows for IE1-configured numbers, SMS is currently the only supported messaging channel in the region (MMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Facebook Messenger, and SMS through Conversations (classic) are not supported).
- **Independent regional isolation:** High availability runs natively within AWS eu-west-1. IE1 and US1 operate as completely independent silos to protect data boundaries, meaning any cross-region disaster recovery or failover strategies should be managed at your application layer.
- **Regulatory scope:** IE1 is specifically engineered to satisfy strict EU data localization and residency mandates. (Note that HIPAA compliance remains exclusive to Twilio’s US1 region).


Great customer experience is about building automated paths smart enough to resolve simple requests fast, and seamless enough to hand off to a human agent with full context when things get tricky. Running Studio, TaskRouter, and Functions & Assets together in IE1 gives your organization the speed, compliance confidence, and regional isolation to deliver both.


Ready to see how easy secure European workflows can be? Read the Twilio IE1[regional documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/global-infrastructure/regional-product-and-feature-availability#ireland-ie1-region) and get started today!
